name: Adam Gray
stance: Endorses Rep. Whitesides's call for a pause or safety stand-down at frontier AI labs to assess risks before moving ahead.

statements.text: AI has enormous potential, but moving fast shouldn’t mean ignoring serious risks. George makes a compelling case for borrowing a lesson from aerospace: when the stakes are high, taking the time to understand the risks and put the right safeguards in place is just common sense.
